name: 連絡先一覧の主要アクション帯
prompt:
Recreate only the compact Salesforce contact-actions segmented control in the primary source crop. Match its 635:43 aspect ratio (about 14.77:1), thin dark-gray outer outline with rounded end caps, white button faces, five adjoining segments and narrow internal dividers. No Japanese mock exists for this added source.

Show exactly five centered blue text buttons in this order, with no icons: 「インポート」, 「新規」, 「キャンペーンに追加」, 「メールを送信」, 「ラベルを割り当て」. Preserve the source segment widths proportionally: first narrow, second narrowest, third widest, fourth medium, fifth medium-wide.

Use compact medium-weight blue sans-serif labels, subtle white/light-gray fills, thin charcoal outlines and no gaps between segments. Keep the whole control as one short horizontal strip filling the canvas edge to edge. Do not add a heading, icons, extra buttons, surrounding Salesforce page, or blank margins.
reviewNotes: Candidate v001 preserves the five Japanese actions and segmented-control order. Dimensions are 2172x724 (3.00:1) against source 635x43 (14.7674:1); SHA-256 7c4b6f7a60188ffbf8547a51bc8101d7359daea454a088213411300fc8c35bb3. The control content is centered in a 3:1 canvas with large blank top and bottom margins. The prior 0255 tight-crop attempt returned the same fixed 3:1 canvas, so no identical retry was made. Status: needs-correction due to aspect-ratio limitation.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
